projects.title: Makinang na Kulintang

projects.title: Light Sequencer
projects.description: An Arduino connected to a Pure Data patch playing procedural music where each light is associated with a different instrument.

projects.description: A VST instrument plugin in Kontakt. The Saranay is a smaller version of its predecessor, Kulintang, from Mindanao Philippines

projects.title: Feel the Beat Critter
